The '''1959 Danish 1st Division''' season was the 14th edition of [[Danish 1st Division]] annual [[Association football|football]] competition in Denmark. It was contested by 12 teams.

[[Vejle Boldklub]] unsuccessfully defended its [[1958 Danish 1st Division|1958 title]]. [[Boldklubben 1909]] successfully pursued its 1959 title.

Statistics of [[Danish 1st Division]] in the 1959 season.
